'''Kendrell Alexander Bell''' (born July 2, 1978) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[linebacker]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Georgia Bulldogs football|Georgia Bulldogs]] and was selected by the [[Pittsburgh Steelers]] in the second round of the [[2001 NFL draft]]. In his first year with the Steelers, Bell was named [[NFL Defensive Rookie of the Year]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=2001 NFL Draft Listing |url=https://www.pro-football-reference.com/years/2001/draft.htm |access-date=2023-03-18 |website=Pro-Football-Reference.com |language=en}}</ref> He later played for the [[Kansas City Chiefs]] before retiring following the 2007 season.

'''Kendyl LeMarc Jacox''' (born June 10, 1975) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was an [[offensive guard]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Kansas State Wildcats football|Kansas State Wildcats]].

Jacox appeared in 58 games for the [[San Diego Chargers]] between 1998 and 2001, including 30 starts. After signing with the [[New Orleans Saints]] in 2002, Jacox appeared in 56 games - starting all but one - between 2002 and 2005.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kendyl Jacox Stats, Height, Weight, Position, Draft, College |url=https://www.pro-football-reference.com/players/J/JacoKe20.htm |access-date=2024-11-02 |website=Pro-Football-Reference.com |language=en}}</ref>

After a rash of injuries at the right guard position during training camp and preseason, the [[Miami Dolphins]] signed Jacox as a free agent on September 3, 2006.
